# Lists Hooks

React hooks for all!

## Development

Ensure that all dependencies are install via `npm ci`, then:

`npm run lint` - Lints the source code

`npm test` - Run tests.

## Changelog Versioning

In your first merge request for a change, add a list of proposed changelog items in CHANGELOD.md in the "## [Unreleased]" section at the top.

After your changes have been merged and you push a new version (see Publishing a New Version below), put in another merge request moving your changes from "## [Unreleased]" to a new release version right below that section.

## Publishing a New Version

Publish new versions on master

Publishing a new version will require 4 parts

- Knowing your current version
- Knowing what kind of change your version is considered to be
- pushing the new tagged version
- passing CI

Be sure `lists-hooks` is your current working directory

Run `git fetch --all` to ensure you have the most current versions locally.

Run `git describe --tags` to inspect the most current version of your repo. (You'll need this result for later)

As an example, let's say the output of the current version of our published repo is `@joltup/lists-hooks@2.1.2`.

Note: To decide what version you should update the repo to, follow semantic versioning as described here https://www.jvandemo.com/a-simple-guide-to-semantic-versioning/

Continuing in our example, and knowing that our current version is `@joltup/lists-hooks@2.1.2` from running the previously listed bash command. Let's say for example that we made a backwards compatible bug fix, and we only want to make a minor patch version change. We know we'll want to update from `2.1.2` to `2.1.3`.

Therefore we will run `git tag @joltup/lists-hooks@2.1.3` (notice the update version now). Which sets the current repo to have a new version.

Then I would push the update tag version up with git using `git push origin @joltup/lists-hooks@2.1.3` (notice again the new version #)

At this point your new version will be passing through the CI server and if it passes, you'll have published a new version.
